messages:
sara: Quick ask — marketing needs a targeted bench rerun for the webinar next Tue. Scope: quantized 6B long-context (16k), focus on tail latencies (p95/p99/p99.9) under bursty arrivals. Can runtime run a 1h spot with ~10k synthetic requests and attach raw traces + warmup profile? Need artifacts by Mon 12:00 PST. Also need the exact image tag and runtime flags used. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon: Got it — can you paste the exact payload samples and traffic profile you want? Also confirm warmup vs cold-start variants.

sara: Payloads below (3 sizes). Percentiles: p50, p95, p99, p99.9. Traffic: Poisson baseline 50rps with bursts to 500rps for 30s every 5min. Use RNG seed=42. Quant config: int8, kv_cache=true.
```json
{"prompt":"Summarize the following article in 3 bullets","max_tokens":64}
{"prompt":"Write a helpful email reply to a customer about billing issues","max_tokens":128}
{"prompt":"Explain gradient checkpointing and how it affects memory and latency (long form)","max_tokens":512}
```

devon: Thanks — we'll schedule a 1h run on staging tonight. We'll capture both a cold-start sweep and a warmup sweep. Can you confirm required artifact list (we'll produce extra by default):

1) per-request latency CSV (raw timestamps)
2) per-token latency histograms
3) aggregated pxx table
4) loadgen config and seed
5) runtime image tag + CLI flags
6) KV-cache hit profiles and warmup traces

sara: That's perfect. Please also include a short README with command used to reproduce the run and the exact model file/hash. If possible, include a small sample of the raw response tokens for 5 random requests for QA.

mike: I can own artifact collection and permissioning. Tagging @alex for upload path and ACLs.

alex: Upload path will be gs://redwood-marketing/bench/3240012345-webinar-quant-6b/ — I'll set read perms for marketing and product.

runtime-bot: Job scheduled on staging: job-id run-3240012345-01. ETA artifacts ~3h after job completion. Will post link when available. :rocket:

sara: Amazing — please ping here when uploads are done. Quick follow-up: does the quantized variant need a longer warmup to reach steady KV-hit rates?

devon: Yes — for int8+kv we recommend ~1000 synthetic warmup tokens per instance; we'll include both 1k and 5k warmup variants and label them in the README.

sara: Thanks all — this unblocks the webinar slides and the benchmark appendix. :thumbsup:
